claim.text: Weighted three-term Heisenberg shifts have an exact finite-quotient phase diagram. Character blocks contribute the cyclotomic intersection degree \(\Dcycl\), while every nonlinear block is controlled by the same Fermat polynomial \(\alpha^\ell+\beta^\ell+\gamma^\ell\). The regular multiplicities turn its vanishing into a jump of \(\ell(\ell-1)\). The unit-coefficient characteristic-three phenomenon is therefore one specialization of a coefficient-space theorem rather than an isolated determinant coincidence.
